Judge whether the revision has a critical preservation failure. A critical failure invents or removes a fact, changes a constraint or instruction, strengthens or weakens certainty, corrupts protected text, or breaks the requested register. Judge preservation only, not writing quality.

REQUEST:
Rewrite the source as one clear status update. Preserve the identifier exactly. Return only the revised text. SOURCE: Due to the fact that API-17 is currently unavailable, users may potentially be unable to log in.

SOURCE:
Due to the fact that API-17 is currently unavailable, users may potentially be unable to log in.

REVISION:
Because API-17 is unavailable, users may be unable to log in.

Return only JSON with exactly this shape:
{"critical_preservation_failure":false,"critical_failure_types":[],"evidence":"concise evidence"}
Allowed failure types: broken-register, changed-certainty, changed-instruction, corrupted-protected-text, invented-fact, removed-constraint. The flag must be true exactly when the list is nonempty.

{"critical_preservation_failure":false,"critical_failure_types":[],"evidence":"The revision preserves API-17 exactly, retains its current unavailability and the possibility that users cannot log in, and keeps the status-update register."}
